biotools.summary: MiMiCPy-FM is a user-friendly tool that automates the parametrization of biomolecular force fields using force matching (FM) algorithms. It extends the time scale of QM/MM Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, enabling a seamless transition to classical MD.
